other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed and under a career break due to family commitments or related matters at the time of application
Applicant must not receive any emoluments from any source at the time of application
Applicant must have a minimum of 60% marks in post‑graduation
Applicant must have a qualified Ph.D. in Science/Engineering subjects
Applicant must have published at least one research paper in an SCI journal or secured a patent
Applicant must not have previously availed a KSCSTE Back‑to‑Lab Fellowship for their PhD programme
Applicant must not have previously received any Post‑Doctoral Fellowship from KSCSTE or elsewhere

Research centre must be different from the Ph.D. research centre and must be a R&D institution or university department in Kerala classified as a Government Institution (or premier national institutions such as IISER, IIT, IISc outside the state)

A Scientist Mentor who is a regular faculty/staff of the institution must be appointed, with at least 5 years of service left before retirement, and must monitor the project and ensure timely submission of financial utilization certificates
The fellow must undertake that she is not availing financial assistance/stipend from any other source simultaneously
The fellow must not enter into collaboration with a foreign party without prior approval of the Council
Any unutilized portion of the grant (including interest) at the end of the project must be refunded to KSCSTE
benefits_summary: Post‑doctoral fellowship of ₹45,000 per month plus 10% HRA and an annual contingency grant of ₹75,000 for up to 2 years.
